assets.name: base-mon
assets.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE completely original production card-frame asset for LORE, an elegant anime fantasy magical library game. Brand-new design, NOT a recolor or adaptation of a conventional heavy gold TCG frame. Visual language like refined Genshin Impact interface craftsmanship: airy ivory ceramic, matte pearl silver, very thin pale champagne accents, delicate celestial compass geometry, generous art, restrained dusty garnet red identifying MONSTER. No ornate double/triple gold rectangular borders, no wood, no parchment.
Portrait PNG 1024x1536, front-on flat UI. Frame fills canvas x2..98 y1..99. Silhouette with gently arched top edge, tiny diamond compass finial top center and tapered bottom corners. Main border is slim ivory/silver with a clearly readable garnet-red enamel ribbon along side edges. Upper blank name plaque x25..91 y4..12 is dark muted garnet, simple refined shape. Blank cost disc x1..24 y1..16, navy blue with a thin ivory rim, NO NUMBER. Huge uninterrupted solid midnight-navy art placeholder window x7..93 y16..88; this navy will be covered by runtime artwork. At bottom corners integrated EMPTY attack emblem (cool blue circular/diamond shape) x1..25 y83..99 and EMPTY HP emblem (muted red shield) x75..99 y83..99, restrained elegant inset surfaces for live digits. NO effect box, NO text panel below artwork. Tiny silver compass mark bottom center. No text, no digits, no card illustration, no logos, no extra icons. All decorative artwork fully raster painted. Outside the silhouette solid black; no checkerboard. Pristine premium simple craftsmanship, subtle dimensional light on ceramic edges, ultra crisp.
